extractions.value: Over several months a 58-year-old man developed muscle stiffness, myoclonus and experienced several sudden falls caused by sensory and acoustic stimuli. On neurological examination, a severe startle reaction could be triggered by unexpected noises and there was stiffness, especially of the back and lower limb muscles, with myoclonus, lower limb paraparesis, muscle rigidity and increased tendon reflexes without further pyramidal signs.
